definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is new to a field but shows exceptional talent and vigor. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) used as a complimentary expression for young professionals, artists, scholars, or athletes with bright futures.

examples.japanese: {新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}した→設計する：26916_sekkeisuru⟧。
examples.english: It was designed by an up-and-coming architect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She is attracting attention as a promising young researcher.

examples.japanese: {新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{独創的|どくそうてき}→独創的：06242_dokusouteki⟧な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}→披露：09683_hirou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An event gathering up-and-coming chefs was held, and creative dishes were showcased.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) used almost exclusively as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective modifier before a person's title or occupation: {新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧ (an up-and-coming painter).

USAGE:
Always complimentary. Used in introductions, profiles, and media coverage to praise someone who is new but talented. Implies both newness ({新進|しんしん} = newly advancing) and sharp ability ({気鋭|きえい} = spirited and keen).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧: up-and-coming painter
- {新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧: promising young scholar
- {新進気鋭|しんしんきえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: rising company
